title: Risks of Cultural Erasure in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model to describe 50 global cities and using human annotators to code the generated text for representational themes (such as culture vs. economy) to measure cultural simplification. Additionally, prompting the model with travel interest queries (e.g., art, history, spirituality) to measure the omission or inclusion of diverse cultural representations.
Extracting and analyzing the empirical probability of specific global regions, sub-regions, and cities being recommended or entirely omitted in model-generated travel recommendations.
